summary: Iter 30 + 30b regression + feature retest across backend and frontend. All 23 pytests pass (13 new in iteration20 + 7 iter30 + 3 iter30b). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: admin spend chart on /tokens renders with all three data-testids; LinkedIn share buttons on /certificates open a LinkedIn profile-add URL prefilled with cert code; mind-map thumbnail persists round-trip via PUT and appears as data-testid='mindmap-thumb-1' on /courses admin card; regression sanity on /dashboard, /courses, /certificates, /tokens, /learning-paths, /users all clean (no 500s). Redis-backed rate limiter triggers 429 with Retry-After header under rapid-fire. Public catalog gated behind bearer token with read:catalog scope.

issues: Mindmap thumbnail overlay renders on card but visual contrast is low against the purple cover placeholder — the testid is present and functional, but a small border/shadow around the overlay would improve visibility (non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: Backend rate_limit_service uses Redis with in-memory fallback — verified path via REDIS_URL from env, and Retry-After header is emitted on 429. Good.
Course summary schema now correctly surfaces mindmap_thumbnail_svg (verified via GET /api/courses list + GET /api/courses/{id}). No _id/ObjectId leaks observed.
Mind-map PUT enforces 200 KB pydantic max on thumbnail_svg (422 verified). Good defensive validation.
LinkedIn share button uses window.open with a well-formed LinkedIn profile-add URL including startTask, name, organizationName, issueYear/Month, certUrl, and certId. Solid implementation.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_retest.py (new — Redis 429 + public catalog scope + admin/learner regression matrix)
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created + deleted a 'TEST_catalog_reader' API token in test_public_catalog_with_valid_token; PUT+DELETE mindmap layout on course id=1 (test cleans up via subsequent DELETE assertion). Verify page traffic seeded rate-limit state; test flushes Redis before running.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 30+30b features are fully green on backend and frontend. If the P0 batch continues, run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) redis-cli flushdb && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_retest.py /app/backend/tests/test_iteration30.py /app/backend/tests/test_iteration30b.py -v` to regress. LinkedIn button click behavior was verified by intercepting window.open (buttons dispatch via onClick, not href). Course id=1 has an intentionally persisted mindmap thumbnail from testing — delete via `DELETE /api/authoring/mindmap/1/layout` if a clean baseline is needed.
